title: TerraPower
summary: US advanced-reactor company founded by Bill Gates, building a sodium fast reactor.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

TerraPower is developing the Natrium sodium-cooled fast reactor with molten-salt energy storage, and has begun construction of a demonstration plant in Wyoming. It also works on fuel fabrication and medical isotopes. Regulatory approval and cost control are the main hurdles.

Technology Exposure

  • Sodium fast reactor
  • Molten-salt storage
  • Advanced fuel development

What To Watch

  • Demonstration plant construction
  • NRC licensing
  • Cost and schedule

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
